description_en: Applies a scaling configuration of the Elastic Container Instance type. If you want to create and manage scaling configurations of the Elastic Container Instance type by using a configuration file, you can call the ApplyEciScalingConfiguration operation
description_zh: 如果您需要通过配置文件方式快速创建和管理ECI类型的伸缩配置，则可以通过调用API ApplyEciScalingConfiguration来创建或更新ECI类型的伸缩配置
kebab_example: aliyun ess apply-eci-scaling-configuration --content apiVersion:_apps/v1_kind:_Deployment_metadata:_name:_nginx-deployment_labels:_app:_nginx_spec:_replicas:_3_selector:_matchLabels:_app:_nginx_template:_metadata:_labels:_app:_nginx_annotations:_k8s.aliyun.com/eip-bandwidth:_10_k8s.aliyun.com/eci-with-eip:_true_spec:_containers:_-_name:_nginx_image:_nginx:1.14.2_ports:_-_containerPort:_80 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --format YAML --scaling-group-id asg-bp1igpak5ft1flyp0000 --scaling-configuration-id asc-bp1i65jd06v04vdh0000 --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ApplyEciScalingConfiguration

parameters.description_en: The content of the configuration file.
parameters.example:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx-deployment
  labels:
    app: nginx
  spec:
    replicas: 3
    selector:
       matchLabels:
        app: nginx
    template:
      metadata:
        labels:
          app: nginx
        annotations:
          k8s.aliyun.com/eip-bandwidth: 10
          k8s.aliyun.com/eci-with-eip: true
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: nginx
            image: nginx:1.14.2
            ports:
            - containerPort: 80
parameters.help_en: The content of the configuration file
parameters.name: content

parameters.description_en: Optional. Set the value to YAML.
parameters.description_zh: 可选，默认值格式为YAML，当前仅支持YAML格式。
parameters.help_en: Optional. Set the value to YAML
parameters.help_zh: 可选，默认值格式为YAML，当前仅支持YAML格式
parameters.name: format

parameters.description_en: The ID of the scaling group.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the scaling configuration.

If you want the system to update a scaling configuration of the Elastic Container Instance type based on a YAML configuration file, you must specify `ScalingConfigurationId`. If you do not specify `ScalingConfigurationId`, the system creates a new scaling configuration based on the YAML configuration file.
parameters.description_zh:
待修改伸缩配置的ID。

当基于Content配置信息更新ECI类型的伸缩配置时，指定`ScalingConfigurationId`；当未指定`ScalingConfigurationId`时，基于Content配置信息会新建ECI类型的伸缩配置。
